frozenDescriptorMetadata.displayName: Ступенчатый модуль · внутренний угол, верхняя, левая
frozenDescriptorMetadata.collisionPolicy: simple-imported-physical-v1: one ordinary bounded cuboid by default; reviewed doorway/arch, stair/landing and ladder exceptions use at most three useful boxes; passable source planes stay passable. Eight orientations use a few ordinary AABBs bounded by the actual transformed visual vertices, never strips or a second expanded rotated AABB. Six root-cell-face overflows strictly smaller than 0.5 blocks are cropped independently after instance yaw, vertical mount and SourceShift; long extents are retained. Selection and visuals unchanged. Not authored Collision Studio data.
frozenDescriptorMetadata.geometryPolicy: Source element coordinates, face UV, rotations, display, textures and parent inheritance unchanged; only dependency namespace remapped.
